stops.title: Nhwɛmu no
stops.caption: Obiara, wɔ nhwɛmu baako mu.
stops.speech: Asɔrefoɔ ne nhwɛmu no. Obiara a ɔwɔ asɔre no mu wɔ ha, ne n’asɔre baa ne sɛ wawie asɔrefoɔ adesua no anaa.

stops.title: Obi hwehwɛ
stops.caption: Fa din, email anaa telefon.
stops.speech: Twerɛ din, email anaa telefon nɔma wɔ hwehwɛbea hɔ. Wotumi nso yi no mu fa asɔre baa, gyinabea anaa dibea so.

stops.title: Bue obi nsɛm
stops.caption: N’abakɔsɛm nyinaa wɔ faako.
stops.speech: Sɛ womia nsensaneɛ a, ɛbue saa onipa no: ne nkitahodie, n’akuo, ne mmaeɛ ne nkɔdi akyi biara a ɛfa ne ho.
